**Finding: compliant** (rule ASSIGN, ¶ p0072 — miscellaneous section (h)).

The assignment clause already delivers our preferred position on the material terms:

- **AP's assignment rights** — express consent-free carve-out for assignment to an affiliate, to a purchaser of all or substantially all assets relating to the subject matter, or to a successor by merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction.
- **Consent standard** — for any other assignment, consent "shall not be unreasonably withheld."
- **Change of control** — no change-of-control concept exists anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "change of control" and "control" return only indemnity, force majeure and insolvency references), so Kubient has no termination or re-pricing right triggered by an AP change of control.

Two preferred sub-elements are missing but immaterial and noted in the rationale rather than redlined: there is no express prohibition on Kubient assigning to an AP competitor, and Kubient enjoys the same consent-free carve-out AP does (symmetry we accepted at the fallback). No redline proposed.
